lists.name: HISTORICAL ORIGINS OF IDEONOMY
items: DOUGLAS LENAT (American) 1950-: computer scientist (noogineering)
HERMAN KAHN (American) 1922-1983: mathematician, physicist, military strategist, futurist, historian, economist, political scientist, sociologist
STANISLAW LEM (Polish) 1921-: science-fiction writer, philosopher, critic, polymath, futurist
DAVID BOHM (American-English) 1917-: physicist, philosopher
MARIO BUNGE (Argentine-Canadian) 1919-: philosopher, physicist
GREGORY BATESON (Anglo-American) 1904-1980: anthropologist
LUDWIG VON BERTALANFFY (Austro-Canadian) 1901-: biologist; founder of General Systems Theory
FRITZ ZWICKY (Swiss-American) 1898-1974: astronomer, physicist, jet-propulsion pioneer, ideonomist
LANCELOT LAW WHYTE (Anglo-American) 1896-1972: banker, physicist, philosopher, inventor, polymath
RICHARD BUCKMINSTER FULLER (American) 1895-1983: architect, mathematician, engineer, inventor, futurist, polymath, philosopher, poet
ARTHUR ONCKEN LOVEJOY (German-American) 1873-1962: philosopher
ALFRED NORTH WHITEHEAD (Anglo-American) 1861-1947: mathematician, philosopher, educationalist
FRIEDRICH NIETZSCHE (German) 1844-1900: philologist, philosopher, cultural critic, poet
CHARLES SANDERS PEIRCE (American) 1839-1914: scientist, mathematician, logician, philosopher, cofounder of semiotics
JEREMY BENTHAM (English) 1748-1832: philosopher, economist, jurist
EMANUEL SWEDENBORG (Swedish) 1688-1772: scientist, mystic, philosopher, theologian
GOTTFRIED WILHELM LEIBNIZ (German) 1646-1716: philosopher, logician, mathematician, scientist (physicist and geologist), historian, linguist, theological theorist; cofounder of calculus
SIR FRANCIS BACON (English) 1561-1626: lawyer, courtier, statesman, philosopher, master of the English language; founder of modern science
LEON BATTISTA ALBERTI (Italian) 1404-1472: poet, scholar, architect, art theorist, mathematician, cartographer, cryptographer
NICHOLAS OF CUSA (German-Italian) 1401-1464: cardinal, mathematician, scholar, experimental scientist, philosopher
